source_snapshot.test_set: AMD CPU RAS -PCIe ACS Fatal Error
source_snapshot.procedure: Requires an ACS-capable NIC, fixed tuple 0:0:1/core3/port0, errortype 4, immediate reset, reboot and post-boot dmesg under literal AER/severity/SyncFlood settings.
source_snapshot.criteria: Fatal error must appear in BERT dmesg after warm reset, OS must report within undefined timeout and lspci must show ACS capability.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; broad live dmesg/SEL collection cannot prove fresh BERT correlation, ACS locus or the reset event, and it includes unrelated PCIe error terms.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: RPUC/CHANGED; adds ACS-capability and recovery gates but does not define which function/port must expose ACS, errortype-4 authority, BERT freshness or per-slot tuple coverage.
source_snapshot.procedure_direct_xlsx: 【Before Test】 1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition. 2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.). 【During Test】 Hardware required: RDIMM with ECC Plug a NIC (Network Interface Card) device on a target PCIe slot on the SUT / HDT Software tool: AMD RAS Error Injection Tool 1. BIOS settings: a. NBIO Common options → ACS Enable: Enable b. NBIO Common options → Enable AER Cap: Enable c. AMD PBS → RAS → Pcie Root Port UnCorr Error Sev Reg: 7EF6030 d. AMD PBS → RAS → Pcie Device UnCorr Error Sev Reg: 7EF6030 e. FCH Common Options → FCH RAS Options → Reset After Sync-Flood: Enable f. NBIO Common Options → NBIO RAS Common Options → SyncFlood on PCIe Fatal Error: True 2. Unlock CPU via HDT. 3. Boot into Ubuntu 20.04/RHEL 2022. 4. Download the AMD RAS Error Injection Tool, then install and open the software. 5. Execute the following command to get a list of devices in the PCIe slots: sudo ./cmdline_amdraserrorinjectiontest --listpcieslotinfo 6. PCIe ACS Fatal Error, enter the following commands: sudo ./cmdline_amdraserrorinjectiontest --pcieerror --sockdienbio 0:0:1 --errortype 4 --pciecore 3 --pcieport 0 6.1. The system will reset immediately. 6.2. When system boot into operating system again, check dmesg log. 【After Test】 1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders. 2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria_direct_xlsx: 1. For Fatal errors, verify that the errors are logged correctly in BERT dmesg after the warm reset is triggered. 3. If the OS reports the error within a timeout period, the test passed. 4. If the OS does not report the error within a timeout period, the test failed. 5. Check in Linux “lspci” command whether the device is ACS capable hardware or not.
source_snapshot.deepseek_direct_xlsx: PARTIAL | -- PCIe slot 1~N: inject the PCIe ACS Fatal on PCIe slot 1~N via the AMD RAS Error Injection Tool (after HDT/unlock + the BIOS RAS knobs from the procedure, e.g. Platform First Error Handling=Enabled + per-unit MCA/UMC settings). Agent stages/verifies with sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "dmesg -T 2>&1 | tail -160 | grep -iE 'pcier|aer|ecrc|lcrc|poisoned|fatal'; echo __PCIe_ACS_Fatal_on_PCIe_slot_1~N; ipmitool sel elist 2>&1 | tail -40 2>&1" but the tool injection step itself is interactive/HW-level and needs the user to drive the exact inject command.

test_case.test_name: PCIe slot 1~N — retained controlled review-layer procedure
test_case.purpose: For every required PCIe slot, inject one approved ACS fatal condition into the exact ACS-capable NIC path, verify the intended immediate warm reset and a fresh target-correlated BERT/CPER record after boot, then prove NIC, link and system recovery.
required_package: Physical slot/NIC serial/FW/driver/BDF/upstream hierarchy to socket/die/NBIO/core/port map for every target
Exact ACS-capable function and required ACS capability/control bits from lspci -vv, not mere keyword presence
AMD tool/spec version/hash/license and proof pcieerror errortype 4 selects the intended ACS fatal stimulus
Decoded 7EF6030, AER masks, DPC, Reset After Sync-Flood and SyncFlood policy
Pre-event BERT inventory, expected new CPER section/source/severity fields and stale-record exclusion method
Supported OS/kernel, reset/firmware/boot deadlines, aborts, OOB recovery, RDIMM relevance and restoration
test_case.test_command: Map each physical slot/NIC and upstream hierarchy to BDF and NBIO/core/port; identify the ACS-capable component and required ACS control bits with lspci -vv; validate tool/errortype 4; snapshot BERT/CPER identity and BIOS/AER policy; under independent OOB console inject one target once; timestamp reset/firmware/boot; decode the new PCIe CPER section and source identifiers; verify link/device/driver health and restore settings before another slot.

safety_gate: Dedicated backed-up SUT with independent BMC/serial console and known-good boot/reimage path
Power/ESD-safe NIC installation; verify live physical/BDF/NBIO mapping and ACS controls before injection
Quiesce traffic and exclude boot or management-critical endpoints unless explicit recovery is approved
Inject once on one mapped target; abort on wrong source, missing reset, boot loop, stale/missing BERT, link/device loss or unexpected escalation
No automatic retry/reset; preserve durable evidence and restore/diff BIOS/HDT/AER/ACS/DPC/SyncFlood state
expected_evidence: Exact platform, NIC, physical slot, BDF hierarchy and NBIO/core/port identity
lspci -vv ACS capability/control locus plus decoded BIOS/AER policy
Tool/spec and one complete errortype-4 injection transcript
OOB timestamp of immediate reset, firmware and boot
Fresh decoded BERT/CPER PCIe section with target/source/severity correlation
Restored NIC/link/driver/system health, configuration and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: If ACS exists only on an upstream function or required controls cannot be safely enabled, retain execution as pending rather than treating endpoint lspci text as sufficient. A previously retained BERT record cannot satisfy freshness.

source_conflict.reason: Slot 1~N is represented by one fixed tuple; the source does not say which endpoint/upstream function must be ACS-capable or which controls are required, nor prove errortype 4. Literal severity is undecoded, BERT freshness/source fields and deadlines are absent, RHEL 2022 and RDIMM relevance are ambiguous, and DeepSeek's live generic logs cannot span reset.
